item.title: Sydney Sweeney Started Her Own Production Company: Fifty-Fifty

item.description: Set photos published October 28 show Sydney Sweeney shooting The Housemaid's Secret, the sequel to the 2025 hit that earned over $400 million worldwide.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney's Anyone But You: $25M Budget, $220M Gross
